arrays.description: nested list of array_like or scalars (but not tuples) If passed a single ndarray or scalar (a nested list of depth 0), this is returned unmodified (and not copied).
constraints: arrays elements shapes must match along the appropriate axes (without broadcasting), but leading 1s will be prepended to the shape as necessary to make the dimensions match.

output.description: ------- ndarray The array assembled from the given blocks. The dimensionality of the output is equal to the greatest of: * the dimensionality of all the inputs * the depth to which the input list is nested
